text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills slipped to 43.09 percent from 47.06 percent at the last sale on October 15, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 6.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.42 million UAH 17.90 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 60,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,309 were competitive and 58,691 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 22.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 49.20 percent from 59.23 percent at the last sale on October 15, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 9.01 million UAH 52.04 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.24 million UAH 40.17 million UAH
The central bank sold 90,118 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 50 were competitive and 90,068 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 22.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.76 percent from 59.79 percent at the last sale on October 15, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 2.898 million UAH 3.04 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.003 million UAH 2.10 million UAH
The central bank sold 28,979 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 27,144 were competitive and 1,835 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 22.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged down to 60.86 percent from 61.46 percent at the last sale on October 15, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 332 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 117 were competitive and 215 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 22. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
